title: How We’re Building the Customer Relationship in Health
summary: Health is shifting from one-off transactions to lifelong relationships. We’re building the platform to earn them in every category and every market.
body_markdown:
At Hims & Hers, we aren’t building around a single product or category. We’re building an everyday digital health platform, and the goal is a relationship with customers that lasts and deepens, not a one-time transaction.


We believe whoever owns that relationship wins. That’s easy to say and very hard to do. Most companies in our industry are built around a single transaction: a treatment, a condition, a moment in time. They win it, but then lose the thread. People want something different – something better. A place that knows them and grows with them as their needs change, and that’s the platform we’re building in three key ways:


**We’re building to win metabolic health.** ‍


For many people, their relationship with us starts with weight loss. It’s one of the largest categories in healthcare, and we believe it’s still in the earliest days of adoption. A strong customer relationship there is what lets us help with the other needs that matter to them. The category is also changing. In Canada, where[generics arrived earlier this year](https://news.hims.com/newsroom/semaglutide-in-canada-just-got-more-affordable) , average monthly orders have grown more than 50% following their launch. We saw a similar pattern in sexual health and hair, where it brought more people into care. As that happens, customers will be able to find every option in one place, with a care team to help them choose what’s right for them.


We’ve built strong relationships with Lilly and Novo that underpin our ability to provide a broad assortment to our customers, alongside an AI-native experience that will be rolled out to every weight loss customer on our platform.


**We’re building to win the major global markets.**


International revenue grew more than 4x year-over-year to $233 million in our first full quarter with Eucalyptus, and the business is on track to reach a $1 billion annual run rate revenue in 2027, a sign that a connected, affordable model of care resonates well beyond the US.


We’re transitioning the Eucalyptus brands to Hims & Hers, so our infrastructure, technology, and breadth of specialties can reach new markets faster. Since August, we’ve introduced both[Hims](https://investors.hims.com/news/news-details/2026/Hims-Enters-Australia-Marking-First-Expansion-into-the-Asia-Pacific-Market/default.aspx) and[Hers](https://news.hims.com/newsroom/hers-launches-in-australia) to Australia,[Hers Hair](https://news.hims.com/newsroom/innovating-for-her) to the UK, and[Hims to Germany](https://news.hims.com/newsroom/introducing-hims-in-germany) .


‍ **We’re building to stay at the forefront of category expansion.**


Our platform is designed to let testing, treatment, and ongoing care work together, so a customer’s next need doesn’t mean starting over somewhere else.


That foundation is what allowed us to expand our already-popular[testosterone offering](https://news.hims.com/newsroom/a-new-era-for-testosterone-care-hims-launches-new-injectable-and-oral-trt-options) to include TRT. It’s built around an at-home blood test and provider-guided treatment that adapts over time, and this comprehensive, accessible approach is why our testosterone specialty continues to progress towards a $100 million annualized revenue run rate.


But this isn’t just a testosterone story. Our approach is built to support any complex health challenge that requires ongoing monitoring and a consistent care team relationship. Next is[Peptides+](https://news.hims.com/newsroom/expanding-safe-access-to-peptides) , with clinician-led treatment plans and access to regular blood testing to monitor progress.


Our ability to continue moving into more and more complex health concerns all rests on years of earned trust, a real understanding of what each customer needs, and the operational rigor to run our own pharmacies and labs. As that infrastructure scales, it gets more efficient, and we intend to pass those savings on to customers, either through lower prices or with more included for the same price.


People come to Hims & Hers for all kinds of reasons. Because of nine years of investment in these capabilities, they’re learning they can rely on us for the entire journey. We’ve built a brand that close to 3 million people trust, and what they come to us for – and where they come from – keeps expanding.


That’s possible because we bring scale to a personal experience with assortment at the foundation. Every customer we serve makes the experience better for the next. This is how we’re building the platform that will redefine how people access healthcare. I can’t wait for you to see what comes next.
